translations.web: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.
translations.bsb: Beloved, you are faithful in what you are doing for the brothers, and especially since they are strangers to you.
translations.kjv: Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;
translations.asv: Beloved, thou doest a faithful work in whatsoever thou doest toward them that are brethren and strangers withal;
